panel.exchange.legend: Exchange chain. Two planets each sit in the sign the other one rules, so the two houses are chained together. The metal tells how the exchange works out, from gold (very good) to broken rusted iron (most difficult). Marks on the chain name the hard houses: craters in the metal for the 6th (illness), a chain that fades out toward the 12th house (loss), crushed rings and a lightning hazard sign for the 8th (sudden chaos), and a snapped open ring for the worst exchange. The knot names the two houses and carries the rank number; the dark discs show the partner planet, at home in the sign it rules.
panel.exchange.note_12th: 12th: with some houses it can also give spirituality.
panel.exchange.rank.3.line: the 6th or the 12th with any other house
panel.exchange.rank.4.line: Khala: the 3rd with a non-dusthana house
panel.exchange.scale_tip: Where each exchange sits, from 1 most difficult to 6 very good. Rank from the two houses. Each rank has its metal.

panel.exchange.thread_locked: Exchange chains are locked in Settings
panel.exchange.thread_tip: Draws every exchange as a metal chain between its two signs. The metal tells the rank.
